mapper.insert: INSERT INTO trainer_schedules (trainer_id, start_time, end_time, is_available, created_at) VALUES (#{trainerId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{isAvailable}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT schedule_id, trainer_id, start_time, end_time, is_available, created_at FROM trainer_schedules WHERE trainer_id = #{trainerId} ORDER BY start_time ASC
